name: To Know Him Is to Love Him

info.album: To Know Him Is To Love Him - The Best Of

podcast.body: This song was a big hit for The Teddy Bears, written by their member Phil Spector. It was this success that prompted Lester Sill to introduce Spector to Jerry Lieber and Mike Stoller for mentorship. "He'd had a big hit with a song called To Know Him Is To Love Him, which he'd written for his group The Teddy Bears."

srcs.source: A History of Rock Music in 500 Songs

podcast.body: The first single by The Teddy Bears, inspired by the epitaph on Phil Specter's father's grave. Sandy Nelson played drums on the track, which went to number one. Although Bruce Johnston has sometimes been credited with playing bass on it, this is considered unlikely as Johnston was primarily a bass player at the time. Nelson's playing, though described as rudimentary, significantly boosted his session career. "Their first single was called to know him as the soul of him, inspired by the epitaph on Specter's father's grave."

srcs.source: A History of Rock Music in 500 Songs
